test_title: PYST 03: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the following sentence in indirect speech.

Ritu said, “I am eating apples.”

options.text: Ritu said that she had been eating apples.
Ritu told that she was eating apples.
Ritu said that she has been eating apples.
Ritu said that she was eating apples.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Ritu said that she was eating apples.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Present continuous "am eating" becomes past continuous "was eating"**
 
 
• Verb "am eating" is changed to "was eating" to match the past continuous tense in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Pronoun "I" is changed to "she"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is converted to "she" to match the third-person perspective in indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• No quotation marks are used in indirect speech.
 
• The reporting clause "Ritu said that" precedes the statement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *Ritu said that she was eating apples.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Ritu said that she had been eating apples.

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "had been eating" changes the meaning to past perfect continuous.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** Ritu told that she was eating apples.
 
 
• Incorrect reporting verb: "told" should be followed by an object, e.g., "told me".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** Ritu said that she has been eating apples.
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "has been eating" suggests present perfect continuous, which is incorrect in this context.
